title: Life Dashboard
soWhat: Splits life goals into short-term tasks and long-term directions: it makes the things to do, habits to build, and progress on long-term goals easy to monitor over time, and brings personal status records together on a single dashboard.
problem: To-do lists such as Google Calendar only record what to do and cannot be tied to a long-term direction; habit building and physical health records are also scattered across other apps, which makes them awkward to keep and observe in one place.
role: Designed and used AI to develop a personal desktop app, integrating the target features into its separate pages.
method: Tasks can be set as required or optional, one-off or recurring, and linked to a long-term personal direction
Life metrics can be customised for activity observation and recorded with the quick-entry feature on the home page for easy statistics and analysis
The related private data stays on the local machine, with a password-encrypted backup export provided

figures.caption: Home overview: today's life metrics (sleep / exercise / reading), essential tasks, and main directions on one page.
Tasks page: ongoing tasks, essential / optional completion rates, and the flow for adding a new life metric.
